name: Roadrunner Flight School
summary: Flight school at Four Corners Regional Airport in New Mexico with a line-item private pilot estimate.
differentiator: Itemizes its FAA-minimum private pilot cost line by line, including the checkride aircraft ($300 for 2 hours) and the test prep course ($279), so each dollar of its $11,248 can be checked.
pricing: Cessna 172 at $150 an hour, Cessna 172RG at $180, instructor $65 an hour. Sales tax not included.

estimate.hoursBasis: FAA minimums: 30 hours with instructor, 10 hours solo, 20 hours of pre and post flight instruction, and 2 hours of aircraft for the checkride, in a Cessna 172 at $150 an hour
estimate.note: Sales tax not included. The page says costs rise with extra flights, lessons or exam retakes.

bestFor: Students in the Four Corners area who want a minimum-hours budget they can check line by line.
skipIf: You need an estimate at more than the FAA minimum number of hours.
watchOut: The estimate assumes the FAA minimum hours; the page says costs rise with extra flights, lessons or retakes.
The page does not say whether the hourly rate includes fuel.
